songs.title: LDCAT
songs.subtitle: Love Don’t Cost a Thang
songs.story: LDCAT was mastered in a coffee shop in downtown London, Ontario, but began in Lagos in 2023, originally as Outside. Its identity passed through different periods of my life, with arrangements taking shape in 2025 and completion coming in 2026.

songs.title: Highest Currency, Gotta Get it
songs.lyrics: lyrics/Hero One - Highest Currency, Gotta Get it.txt
songs.story: …the musical origins of “Highest Currency, Gotta Get it” stretch back through Massive Gang Nation, Lagos and Osogbo, Osun State. The new hook formulation draws from that history. LDCAT can be Latin/Reggaeton. Highest Currency can have an entirely different musical architecture. Both work from Beats & Blues.
